title: How I gave Claude infinite memory
description:
Claude never forgot your context.

It just couldn't find it.

A chat log has no index.

Everything in there weighs the same.

Your key decision sits beside a typo.

So it starts filling gaps.

That's what hallucination actually looks like.

The fix isn't a bigger head.

It's a filing cabinet.

NotebookLM holds the whole session.

A skill dumps it there automatically.

Next time Claude runs one search.

It pulls the answer, not the archive.

Like a library instead of a pile.

Same books. You can find them now.

Infinite memory isn't remembering everything.

It's knowing where to look.

Give Claude somewhere to look.

#claude #notebooklm #memory #hallucination #secondbrain
